combo_label: Capital Cities × Musical Instruments × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Round yellow Mr Man whose grin runs clean from ear to ear; brimming with cheer
Absent-minded Hargreaves chap who makes a sheep in the lane a goose in the rain
Liffey-side home of the Guinness brewery and a statue of Molly Malone
Tall triangular frame of strings plucked by both hands, pedals below
City of ringed canals and bicycle bells, where Anne Frank hid in an attic
Smallest pipe in the woodwind row, cutting shrill and clean over the whole band
Droning Highland set fed by air squeezed from a sack under the elbow
Roger Hargreaves' orange chap with impossibly long arms; what a feather does
Home of K-pop and kimchi, spread along the broad Han River
Thin cane sliver that buzzes against a mouthpiece to start the sound
Deep-voiced strings gripped between the knees and sung by a horsehair bow
Hargreaves fellow no bigger than a pin, who lodges in a matchbox; or petite
